output:
To: Bethan Rees
Subject: Re: Nia's hen - Tenby final plan + money!!

Beth,

Just replying to you, not getting into this on the group email. I’ve just landed off a Lagos so bear with me, my head’s mush.

Would you have another think about coming, even just for Saturday? You don’t have to do Friday at the cottage or spend the whole weekend pretending nothing’s happened. I know things have been horrible since Lowri’s 40th in November. Things were said on both sides and I’m not going to referee it. I do think she’s probably sorrier than she’s letting on, but neither of you is exactly famous for backing down! That’s only my guess, mind.

I keep thinking about you sitting with Nia in the Heath every night when her mam was bad in 2019. You’re not just another name on the hen list to her. She rang me crying last week asking whether you were still coming. She didn’t know then that you’d decided not to, and as far as I know she still doesn’t. I’m not telling you that to make you feel awful, just because I don’t think you realise how much she wants you there.

You’ll be doing a reading for her at Margam on 17th April, and I’d hate for you to look back and wish you’d had this bit with her too. She’ll miss you, Beth.

I swapped my Orlando with Kerry from work to get this weekend off, lost a night stop I really wanted as well, so you can at least come and keep me company for the meal! You’d only need to get to Tenby for 6 on Saturday. Train from Cardiff Central is about two and a half hours, and I’ll pick you up from the station. Meal’s at 7.30, then you can kip in with me — I’ve got the twin room.

No requirement to sort everything out with Lowri first. Just come for Nia, have dinner and stick with me if you want.

And hang on before sending Lowri any money. Leave that for now while you have a think.

Siân xx
